# Impermanente — Selected Essays in English

> J.R. Cruciani is a Madrid-based photographer and member of the Royal Photographic Society who photographs thresholds: arches, tunnels, passages and shorelines as spaces of transit.

English edition of selected essays by J.R. Cruciani, translated and edited from the Spanish originals on impermanente.es.
